notes.title: MindViz V1.1
notes.content:
Version 1.1:
 - Bug removed on the text position Y for the icon node
 - Bug removed when you create a root node if you are on a window
 - Change : the text nodes rectangle to rounded rectangles
 - Change : the task nodes circles
 - Change : the notifications style
 - Change : the close window button now close the application.
